attachments.description: You gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight in dim light within 60 feet. This sight grants no benefit in darkness.

attachments.name: Thermal Optics
attachments.description: As an action, switch to thermal vision for 10 minutes. You can see warm creatures through light obscurement, but not through total cover. Once used, recharge after a short rest.

attachments.name: Smart Rangefinder
attachments.description: When you take the Aim action against a target you can see, your next ranged attack against it before the end of your next turn gains +3 to the attack roll. Once per short rest.

attachments.name: Muzzle Brake
attachments.description: Once on each of your turns when you make a ranged weapon attack, you can reduce the weapon's recoil. You gain +1 on the next attack roll you make with this weapon before the end of your turn.

attachments.name: Concussive Muzzle
attachments.description: Once per short rest, when you hit a Large or smaller creature within 30 feet, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier) or be pushed 10 feet.

attachments.name: Ergonomic Grip
attachments.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity checks made to keep hold of or quickly draw this weapon. This bonus does not apply to attack rolls.

attachments.name: Stabilized Grip
attachments.description: You gain a +2 bonus on ability checks made to resist being disarmed while wielding this weapon. Once per turn, you can ignore disadvantage caused by light recoil.

attachments.name: Precision Grip
attachments.description: When you take the Aim action and do not move before firing, your next attack with this weapon gains +3 to the attack roll.

attachments.name: Quick-Draw Holster Mount
attachments.description: You can draw or stow this weapon once on each of your turns without using your object interaction. It does not grant an additional attack.

attachments.name: Breach Plate / Weapon Shield
attachments.description: While wielding this weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to AC. You gain this benefit only while the weapon is in your hands and you are not incapacitated. This bonus does not stack with another copy of this attachment.

attachments.name: Reinforced Receiver
attachments.description: The weapon has advantage on saving throws against effects that would jam, disable, or damage it. This does not increase its damage.

attachments.name: Overclocked Receiver
attachments.description: Once per short rest, after you hit with this weapon, you can deal an additional 1d6 damage of the weapon's damage type. You cannot use this feature on a critical hit.

attachments.name: Quick-Change Barrel
attachments.description: You can change between compatible ammunition types as a bonus action, provided the ammunition is already loaded or carried.

attachments.name: Precision Bore
attachments.description: The weapon's normal range increases by 25 percent. Its long range is unchanged.

attachments.name: Heavy Bore
attachments.description: When you hit a creature with this weapon at normal range, you can reroll one weapon damage die and must use the new roll. You can do this once per turn.

attachments.name: Quick-Release Magwell
attachments.description: You can reload this weapon as a bonus action once per short rest.

attachments.name: Armor-Piercing Feed
attachments.description: When you hit a creature wearing armor, the attack ignores 1 point of AC granted by nonmagical armor. This does not affect natural armor or cover.

attachments.name: Smart Ammo Feeder
attachments.description: Once per turn when you miss with a smart weapon attack, you can reroll the attack. You must use the new roll. This feature recharges after a short rest.

attachments.name: Compact Folding Stock
attachments.description: You have advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to conceal this weapon. While folded, the weapon's normal range is reduced by 10 feet.

attachments.name: Braced Stock
attachments.description: If you have not moved this turn, you gain +2 on checks and saves made to resist being knocked prone while wielding this weapon.

attachments.name: Precision Stock
attachments.description: When you take the Aim action and remain stationary, your next ranged attack with this weapon gains +2 to the attack roll.

attachments.name: Underbarrel Shield
attachments.description: While wielding this weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to AC. This bonus applies only while the weapon is in your hands and does not stack with the Breach Plate / Weapon Shield.

attachments.name: Smoke Canister Launcher
attachments.description: As an action, launch a smoke canister to a point within 30 feet. It creates a 10-foot-radius heavily obscured area until the end of your next turn. Once used, it recharges after a short rest.

attachments.name: Micro-Grenade Launcher
attachments.description: As an action, launch a grenade to a point within 60 feet. Creatures in a 5-foot radius make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Dexterity modifier), taking 2d6 fire damage on a failed save or half on a success. One grenade; reload with a grenade.

attachments.name: Battery Saver
attachments.description: The weapon consumes half as many energy charges, rounded up, when an effect allows a choice of charge expenditure.

attachments.name: Surge Capacitor
attachments.description: Once per short rest when you hit, deal an additional 1d4 lightning damage.

attachments.name: Capacitor Overdrive
attachments.description: Once per short rest when you hit, deal an additional 1d8 lightning damage. The weapon cannot use this feature again until you finish a short rest.

attachments.name: Guarded Hilt
attachments.description: While wielding this melee weapon, you gain +1 on ability checks made to resist being disarmed. This attachment grants no AC bonus.

attachments.name: Counterweight Pommel
attachments.description: Once per turn after you miss with a melee attack using this weapon, you can add +2 to the attack roll, potentially turning the miss into a hit.

attachments.name: Ceramic Edge
attachments.description: This blade is difficult to detect with basic metal detectors. It grants no attack or damage bonus.

attachments.name: Monomolecular Edge
attachments.description: When you roll a 1 on a damage die for this weapon, you can reroll that die. You must use the new roll.

attachments.name: Defensive Parry Module
attachments.description: When a creature you can see hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to gain +2 AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss. Once per short rest.
